messages:
kevin: T-minus 20 to the window. quick sweep: canary hooks configured? any last-minute pins or cfg changes? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: 2026-03-22T00:00Z -> release/2026-03-22. Canary 7%. Hooks: smoke, embed-check, cost-meter. Rollout plan: 7% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-03-22

maria: Acked. Freeze reminder: from T-25 -> T+75. no DB migrations, no feature flags outside emergency. If you need an exemption DM me.

alex: Pinned runtime image to release tag `v3.5.0-rc1` on staging, will push to stable at canary start. `kubectl patch --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"api","image":"gcr.io/redwood/api:v3.5.0-rc1"}]}}}}'`

jess: Running smoke locally now. Quick note: reranker pod shows elevated GC during load test earlier, added a heap bump to canary config.

kevin: Canaries starting. First hook shows embeddings latency slight uptick (+18ms p50). Not breaching SLO. Continuing to 25%.

ops-oncall: Oncall here. Rollback criteria posted to runbook: error_rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 > 600ms for 3m OR widespread 5xx. I have `deploy-bot rollback --to previous` on standby.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% -> executing smoke+cost checks. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/xyz/canary-2026-03-22

jess: We just saw a short-lived alert from the token-cost detector (one job retried). Looks like a spike of 6s on a batch worker, unrelated to model traffic, marking as noise.

kevin: Pause at 25% for post-smoke. p50=62ms, p95=380ms, error_rate=0.42%. Traces show tail latencies from a single worker node. ops-oncall any objection to continue?

ops-oncall: No objection, but keep an eye on the reranker pod GC. If we get repeated p95 jumps from the same pod, we'll isolate it.

maria: Minor request: don't flip any global flags for the next 60m — we need stable baselines for evals.

alex: Pushing the manual unpin for one canary node to test fallback model variant. Command: `kubectl label pod reranker-abc testing=quant-fallback` (ephemeral).

kevin: After label: canary p95 dropped to 220ms on that pod. Good fallback behavior. Moving to 60% in 4m.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 60% -> initiating autofallback checks. Canary link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-03-22/canary

jess: At 60% we got a transient error-rate blip to 1.2% for 2m, but it dropped after retries. No customer reports. Marking as watched.

ops-oncall: Blip noted. Not meeting rollback threshold (need 5m). Continue to 100% with caution.

kevin: Starting final ramp -> 100%. small autoscaler spin-up on model-serving pool; latency normalizes.

maria: Extending freeze to T+90 for extra handback time (ops asked). I will log the exemption.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026-03-22 rolled to 100%. Summary: canary->full, no rollback. Full summary: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-03-22/summary

ops-oncall: Post-deploy: capturing baseline snapshot and adding runbook note about the reranker GC. Handback to SRE leads scheduled at T+90.

kevin: Post-deploy checks green. Closing this thread unless someone re-opens. :white_check_mark:
